QuestInfo.0: Gaga wants to help Cassandra find her first love. Go see what he has in mind.
QuestInfo.1: Gaga said that if you carry the #i03994398# #bLove Detector#k for 30 minutes, you might get a clue to the whereabouts of Cassandra's first love. Bring it back to Gaga once it's activated.
